about: File a complaint against a healthcare professional or facility in Dubai.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Patients or their carers can apply
A complaint cannot be filed more than 3 years after the event
documents: No documents are required unless asked for
